notes.title: 📣 New Language Support: Brazilian Portuguese is here! 🇧🇷
notes.content:
[h1]Olá, Brasil! 🇧🇷[/h1]

We’re thrilled to announce that Brazilian Portuguese is now fully supported in The Daruma Challenge! Whether you're bouncing through Normal Mode or raging your way through Time Attack, you can now do it all in your native language.

This update includes:

[list]
[*] Full in-game text localization in Brazilian Portuguese
[*] UI elements, tutorials, and all messages fully translated
[*] A big thank-you to our Brazilian players for your patience and support!
[/list]

We hope this makes the game even more enjoyable (and slightly less rage-inducing 😅) for our amazing Brazilian community. If you spot anything odd or have suggestions to improve the localization, don’t hesitate to reach out!

Now…
[b]Levanta, Daruma![/b]
See you at the top.

[b]– Mun Mun Games 🎮[/b]

notes.title: PURGE YOUR FRUSTRATION
notes.content:
[h2]Some new players begged for mercy. As promised, we won't hold your hand. But we did add a little something to help you vent your rage. Let it all out.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482600/8ac0605cb83cc432658b02f20d3029752bb31569.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] fix minor bugs 🔨
[*] leaderboard is always visible by default in the menu 📊
[*] time attack is always visible by default in the menu (but locked before you finish your first run) ⏰
[*] add explosion mechanic 💥
[*] one new trophy to unlock 🏆
[/list]

notes.title: 🔥 Development Update: Leaderboards Are Coming! 🔥
notes.content:
Survivors, get ready to test your skills against the world! 🌍🏆

We’re excited to confirm that Leaderboards will be part of The Daruma Challenge at launch! Whether you want to dominate the global rankings or compete against friends, this new feature will add replayability and challenge to every run.

🌟 What to Expect at Release?
✅ Global Leaderboard – See how you rank against players worldwide.
✅ Friends Leaderboard – Challenge your Steam friends directly.
✅ Personal Best Tracking – Keep pushing your limits!
✅ Real-Time Score Submission – Your best performances will be recorded automatically.

This will be a core feature on day one, so start preparing now… because only the best will survive.

👁️ Stay tuned for more updates as we get closer to launch!

#TheDarumaChallenge #DevelopmentUpdate #Leaderboard
